senses.gloss:
भैरव a. (वी f.) [भीरोरिदं अण्]
1
Terrible, frightful, horrible,
formidable; U. 5. 6.
--2 Miserable.
--3
Relating to Bhairava.
--वः
1 A
form of Śiva (of which {8}
kinds are enumerated).
--2 The
sentiment of terror (भयानक).
--3
Fear, terror.
--4 N. of a musical
mode (राग) calculated to excite
emotions of fear or terror.
--वी
1 A
form of the goddess Durgā.
--2 N.
of a Rāgiṇī in the Hindu musical
system.
--3 A girl of 12 or a young
girl representing the goddess Durgā
at the Durga festival.
--वं Terror,
horror.
--Comp.
--ईशः an epithet of
Viṣṇu (or Śiva ?); so भैरवतर्जकः
--यातना a sort of purificatory
torment inflicted by Bhairava of
Benares on those who die there, to
make their spirits fit for absorption
into the Supreme Spirit.
